name: Ddev Plastiks Industries Limited
summary: Ddev Plastiks Industries Limited manufactures and sells customised plastic compounds in India and internationally. The company offers antifab, filled compounds, and master batches used in packaging industries for making woven and cement bags; PVC compounds used in wire and cable, and construction industries; halogen free flame retardant (HFFR) for electrical wiring, infrastructure, and safety construction applications; and sioplas, XLPE compounds, semicons, and EHV compounds. It also offers engineering plastic compounds used in the white goods, fast moving electrical goods, and electrical and consumer durables industries; anti-fibrillation compound; PVC compounds for wire and cable construction automotive; poly vinyl chloride; and polyethylene. In addition, the company provides, PE, PVC, filled, footwear, pipe, peroxide, and PP (polypropylene) compounds, as well as master batches. It also exports its products. The company was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Kolkata, India. Ddev Plastiks Industries Limited is a subsidiary of Bbigplas Poly Private Limited.
